steps.content:
Both listings are for the **exact same product at the exact same price** - so either seller gets you the same headphones, but one has a much better returns policy:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**

| | **A: Ottervale Audio** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zx6e8a/a | **B: Brackmoor Sound** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zx6e8a/b |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Returns** | **Free 90-day returns. Refund to original payment method.** | **30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.** |
| **Specs** | Identical - 40h battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, USB-C + 3.5mm cable included | Identical - 40h battery with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, USB-C + 3.5mm cable included |

### Recommendation: Buy from **A: Ottervale Audio**

**Why:**

For the same $129.00, same shipping speed, same warranty, and same rating, Ottervale Audio gives you significantly less risk if you don't like the headphones or they don't fit/are uncomfortable:

*   **3x longer return window:** 90 days vs 30 days
*   **Free returns vs. you pay:** Ottervale offers Free returns, Brackmoor requires you to pay return shipping

There is no downside to A compared to B on any other listed factor - price, stock, shipping, warranty, and product specifications are all identical.

If you don't anticipate needing to return them at all, either seller is fine, but Ottervale Audio is the strictly better deal on terms.
